{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Alien''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had a high amount of health, decently fast speed and 30% defense. Additionally, it had the [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], which made it harder to slow down. ==Appearance== The '''Alien''' had its entire body covered up in a blue and yellow space suit. This space suit had a core with a Robux in its torso and multiple neon blue parts on it. On its head, it wore a neon blue helmet. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Mercenary Base]] are quite useful against this. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used to reduce its defense. **As it has [[Freeze Immunity]], freeze defense dropping towers cannot be used. **Some of them, like the [[Electroshocker]], can also be used to slow it down, though as it has multiple immunities it cannot be knocked back, frozen or chilled by them, while only being slowed down by stuns. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} AlienWalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Alien''' on a promotional video. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Alien''' was based on the Aliens that appeared during the Alien Invasion Live Event in ''Pls Donate''. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''Alien''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Alien's''' defense. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''Alien''' removed. {{PlsDonate|[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]|Wave 13|[[Dev]] & Alien|Wave 15 (Easy)|hardt2 = [[Dev]], Alien & [[Breaker4]]|hardw2 = Wave 15 (Hard)|[[UFO (Pls Donate)|UFO]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Alien}}
